content: Screen-region definition in scraping/automation tools converges on three patterns: (1) drag-select on a fullscreen transparent overlay window (Electron/UiPath 'clipping region', screenshot tools) - lowest friction, most common for end users; (2) coordinate config file (x,y,w,h persisted as JSON) - what tools actually store, and what ROI Picker (github.com/mint-lab/roi_picker) reads/writes; (3) template-matching auto-anchor - find a stable UI glyph, derive ROI offsets from it, survives window moves. OpenCV ships cv2.selectROI/selectROIs which returns [x,y,w,h] and is the standard 15-line calibration UI in Python. Best-practice combo: drag-select once to author, persist to JSON, re-anchor via template match on each run so the user does not re-calibrate when the window moves.
